title: LDAP configuration
searchFilterHint: LDAP filter to restrict login to specific groups. Combined with the user search via AND.
allowedGroupsHint: Group names only, no DN — the app builds the DN itself (cn=name,base DN). Leave empty = all successfully authenticated LDAP users may log in.
moderatorGroupsHint: If a user is in both an admin and a moderator group, admin wins.
